hypothesis: A fixed pretrained identity encoder may prevent auxiliary/expert training from changing the reference space; train new evidence to complement a stable anchor rather than simultaneously moving it. This is unproven and does not by itself fix routing/projection harm.
proposed_controls: Same shared-DeMo anchor continued50 with original training
Same anchor ordinary frequency with fixed identity encoder
Same anchor ordinary twins with fixed identity encoder
Same anchor dual axes with fixed identity encoder
Same anchor dual axes with trainable identity encoder

proposed_training.encoder_anchor: Existing complete official shared-DeMo50 best, selected E37; not a fresh CLIP-only experiment

prelaunch_requirements: Review an exact experiment plan and sources before native execution.
Require exact state/shape/class-label mapping from the same full-data anchor.
Strict reload and all7 controlled00 outputs must equal the fixed identity anchor for identical inputs.
Frozen retrieval modules must remain eval and weights/buffers unchanged through real native updates; active parameters/gradients matched across three experts.
An unfrozen-axis continuation separates freezing from warm start; continued DeMo is required to exclude extra epochs.
All5 fixed-best49 banks (245 cases), four enhanced6x49 banks (1176 states), installedGT audit, complete six metrics and true11-minus00/harm-rescue remain required.
fairness: Common anchor was already trained50; stage2 adds50. Report both stages/cost and compare against continued DeMo and same-warmstart ordinary controls. Do not call this one-factor versus freshCLIP M4/M5/M6, or silently treat100 total as50.
success_rule: Preserve original three-dataset +2mAP/+2Rank1 and missing-modality requirements; a candidate must also beat the strong anchor/continued DeMo and same-capacity ordinary experts with positive frozen11-minus00 before expansion.
scientific_limits: Negative M6 alone does not prove gradient conflict, causality, or that freezing will help. Earlier mean/seed-query, metric scaling, RKD alignment, calibration/control splitting and cross-set objectives already tried; not offered as untried fixes.
validation_storage: One frozen49 bank remains remote through its enhanced audit so full11 matrix equality is retained; stream/audit/localarchive each enhanced raw condition before the next. Archive-sensitive phases serialized. Future NN integration not implemented.
